objective: Reducir drásticamente la latencia del cobro múltiple CANON eliminando el refresh completo entre cada deuda, conservando payment.create, idempotencia y validación backend.
owner_authorization: Owner reportó demora visible en Procesando... durante un cobro múltiple y pidió que el procesamiento sea al instante.
invariants: payment.create remains the only backend payment command
Each allocation keeps its own operation_id and durable PENDING/CONFIRMED journal transition
The fast path holds the CANON writer lock for the whole selected batch
A new payment still skips the redundant status GET because the Worker validates authority and credit revision atomically
ACK-loss retry must replay the same operation_id exactly once before continuing
No full canonical refresh occurs between selected debts
Exactly one background reconciliation refresh occurs after the batch finishes or partially stops
No optimistic success is shown before all required payment receipts are durable
No D1, schema, backend, Caja, credit balance or business-rule changes
rollback: Revertir el PR completo; no hay migraciones ni cambios de datos.
